sources.title: Sarajevo planira obradu do 15.000 tona biootpada godišnje - JKP RAD raspisao tender za studiju o kompostani i biogasnom postrojenju
sources.why_relevant: Planned FBiH (Kanton Sarajevo) composting + biogas plant at Smiljevići landfill naming yard/garden and kitchen bio-waste; kitchen waste to be treated by anaerobic digestion, biogas for electricity and heat via CHP.
sources.quote: Prema tenderskoj dokumentaciji, projekat podrazumijeva izradu studije opravdanosti i idejnog rješenja za kompostanu i biogasno postrojenje koje bi omogućilo efikasno zbrinjavanje vrtnog i kuhinjskog otpada, odnosno njegovo pretvaranje u korisni kompost i biogas. Za vrtni otpad predviđen je proces kompostiranja... Kada je riječ o kuhinjskom otpadu, planirano je njegovo zbrinjavanje kroz biogasno postrojenje zasnovano na anaerobnoj digestiji... Predviđeno je da se proizvedeni biogas koristi za proizvodnju električne i toplotne energije putem kogeneracijskog sistema. Dokumentacija predviđa da bi početni kapacitet kompostane iznosio oko 5.000 tona vrtnog biootpada godišnje... Biogasno postrojenje bi u početnoj fazi obrađivalo oko 250 tona kuhinjskog otpada godišnje, dok bi dugoročni cilj bio povećanje kapaciteta na 5.000 tona godišnje.
sources.quote_en: Translation: The project foresees a feasibility study and conceptual design for a composting and biogas plant to treat yard and kitchen waste... Yard waste: composting. Kitchen waste: treatment in a biogas plant based on anaerobic digestion... biogas for electricity and heat via CHP. Initial composting capacity ~5,000 t/yr yard bio-waste; biogas plant initially ~250 t/yr kitchen waste, long-term target 5,000 t/yr.

sources.title: FEDERALNI PLAN UPRAVLJANJA OTPADOM KNJIGA 2 – PLAN (Nacrt) Mart, 2026
sources.why_relevant: Official FBiH entity-level waste plan draft 2026–2030 (FMOiT, prepared with Enova/CENER 21) covering biowaste management and analyzing biogas plants for biowaste including green-area waste.
sources.quote: U 2023. odvojeno je prikupljeno 2.560,17 tone biorazgradivog otpada i 421,32 tone biorazgradivog otpada iz kuhinja i kantina. U ukupnoj količini komunalnog otpada biorazgradivi otpad ima najveći udio (više od 26%). ... Do 2032. godine, najmanje 10% proizvedenog biorazgradivog otpada iz domaćinstava mora biti odvojeno prikupljeno. ... Pored kompostana, analizirana je uspostava biogasnih postrojenja za biorazgradivi otpad u kojima je planiran tretman biorazgradivog otpada iz domaćinstava, sa zelenih površina, otpada iz klaonica, otpad iz djelatnosti kao što su: stočarstvo, poljoprivreda, ratarstvo (farme domaćih životinja, vinogradi,
sources.quote_en: Translation: In 2023, 2,560.17 t of biodegradable waste and 421.32 t of kitchen/canteen biodegradable waste were collected separately; biodegradable waste is the largest share of municipal waste (>26%). By 2032, at least 10% of household biodegradable waste must be collected separately. ... Besides composting plants, the establishment of biogas plants for biodegradable waste is analyzed, foreseen to treat household biodegradable waste, waste from green areas, sludge screenings, and waste from activities such as livestock farming, agriculture, horticulture.

sources.title: Experimental and Numerical Analysis of the Co-Digestion Process of Municipal Sludge with Fruit and Vegetable Waste
sources.why_relevant: University of Tuzla (Bosnia and Herzegovina) group's peer-reviewed paper numerically simulating co-digestion with the openly published IWA Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 (ADM1) — the named open AD modeling framework used by a BiH group (ADM1 is a model, not commercial simulator software).
sources.quote: In this work, a simulation of the process of co-digestion of waste sludge with fruit and vegetable waste was carried out numerically, with Anaerobic digestion model no. 1 model (ADM1) and experimentally. ... The International Water Association (IWA) Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1, Batstone et al., has mainly been used for the simulation of digestion for different substrates, and it is already a universally accepted model for anaerobic digestion. Authors: Papraćanin, Stuhli, Alić, Abdel Djozić, Zohorović — Faculty of Technology, University of Tuzla, Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina.

notes: NOT FOUND: no measured methane yield (BMP or similar) for Bosnian yard, park or garden waste — searched bs/sr/hr and EN (BMP + vrtnog/baštenski/zeleni otpad queries). Only a Serbian University of Novi Sad AMPTS paper surfaced (substrates: sewage sludge, manure, silage, straw — no yard waste, not BiH) plus non-BiH studies. No tariff figure separately located; no operating yard-waste AD plant identified — only the planned Sarajevo biogas unit (kitchen waste; yard waste goes to composting). First-slice sources were not reused. Quotes from fmoit.gov.au PDF verified via direct extraction plus search-indexed text of the same opened page.
